questions.explanation:
## Why This Is Asked

Interviews for advanced E2E testing roles benefit from scenarios that combine media streaming, network variability, and cross-region data handling. This question probes how candidates model content, simulate real-world conditions, and validate end-to-end correctness with observability.

## Key Concepts

- End-to-end media playback with ABR
- Network emulation and regional CDN behavior
- DRM/licensing verification and caching semantics
- Telemetry collection and end-state assertions
- Test data isolation and flakiness mitigation

## Code Example

```javascript
// Example skeleton using Playwright for ABR-focused playback test
import { test, expect } from '@playwright/test'

test('ABR playback across regions', async ({ page, browser }) => {
  await page.goto('https://stream.example.com/player')
  // simulate region via CDN endpoint switch
  // simulate network conditions and verify transitions
  // assertions on startup time, buffering, and end of playback
})
```

## Follow-up Questions

- How would you extend tests to cover offline playback scenarios?
- How do you ensure test data isolation across tenants and regions while keeping tests fast?
